quick.title: Quick Deploy
quick.subtitle: Pick the approach that fits your needs and get a demo-ready real system in a few steps
quick.autoDesc: Describe your business in one sentence and AI handles the database, proposal and UI generation automatically; get a demo-ready system in about 30-90 seconds, ideal for clear, simple scenarios.
quick.hybridDesc: A step-by-step wizard helps you sort out business objects, fields and relations; adjust anything manually and let AI assemble the result, ideal for rich, complex requirements.
quick.manualDesc: Write SQL to build tables directly with a visual designer; AI only assists and never decides, ideal for database-savvy users who want full control over the structure.
